performance_source_decision.reason: README documents chick counts only at Capes Royds and Crozier; Cape Bird is not covered, so this source cannot assign a performance predictor to all three Ross Island choice colonies.
performance_source_decision.frozen_fallback: banded-breeder chick-presence index reconstructed from USAP-DC 601444 resight records

breeder_season_eligibility.breeder_state: Individual-season must be classified BR under ROSS_ISLAND_STATE_RECONSTRUCTION_V1.
breeder_season_eligibility.colony: Use the unique breeding colony established by BR evidence.
breeder_season_eligibility.interpretable_chick_observation: At least one resight row in that breeder-season must have Chicks in {0,1,2,8}. Rows with Chicks=9 are ignored for chick-presence classification.
breeder_season_eligibility.success: 1 if any interpretable row has Chicks in {1,2,8}.
breeder_season_eligibility.failure: 0 if at least one interpretable row exists and every interpretable row has Chicks=0.
breeder_season_eligibility.unknown: Exclude breeder-season from the performance denominator if all Chicks entries are 9 or otherwise uninterpretable.
breeder_season_eligibility.one_record_per_bird: Each breeder contributes exactly one binary chick-presence value per season regardless of number of resights.

colony_year_index.raw_index: number of eligible breeder-seasons with chick_presence=1 divided by number of eligible breeder-seasons with interpretable chick presence
colony_year_index.three_colony_completeness: A breeding season is eligible as a performance year only if all three Ross colonies each have at least 20 eligible breeder-seasons.
colony_year_index.standardization: Within each eligible performance year, z-standardize the three raw colony indices across CROZ, ROYD and BIRD; call the standardized predictor P_c,t.
colony_year_index.name: banded-breeder chick-presence index

temporal_alignment.colony_size_control: MAPPPD log1p breeding pairs for c,y-1 under ROSS_ISLAND_COLONY_SIZE_CONTROL_V1

choice_event_eligibility_effect.performance: Every colony in the individual's frozen candidate set must have P_c,y-1. Otherwise exclude the entire first-breeding event.
choice_event_eligibility_effect.colony_size: Every candidate colony must also have valid MAPPPD size for y-1. Otherwise exclude the entire event.
choice_event_eligibility_effect.bird_gap: Because Cape Bird resighting effort is unavailable/intermittent after 2013, a performance year lacking valid BIRD breeder data cannot be rescued by using only Royds/Crozier.

primary_choice_model.inherited_candidate_set: Union of distinct PB-visited Ross colonies in the two seasons before first breeding.
primary_choice_model.formula: chosen_colony ~ P_c,y-1 + natal_colony_indicator + log1p(MAPPPD breeding_pairs_c,y-1), stratified by individual first-breeding event.
primary_choice_model.inference: Use the 100000 within-performance-year colony-label permutation defined in ROSS_ISLAND_RESIGHT_SCHEMA_GATE_V1.
primary_choice_model.minimum_information: Use the unchanged minimum-information gate from ROSS_ISLAND_RESIGHT_SCHEMA_GATE_V1.

secondary_external_calibration.role: If its column schema becomes available without movement-outcome inspection, compare annual Royds-vs-Crozier ordering with the banded-breeder chick-presence index descriptively.

observation_effort_boundary: This index is based on banded breeders and may not represent whole-colony productivity.
Unknown chick checks are excluded rather than coded as failures.
Multiple resights do not give a breeder extra weight.
The index may reflect both true reproductive outcome and observation process; it is used as a pre-settlement colony-year state, not as an unbiased census of chicks.
claim_boundaries: A positive choice coefficient would support settlement toward colonies with higher prior banded-breeder chick presence among colonies actually prospected; it would not prove that chicks themselves were the cue.
Do not relabel the index as whole-colony reproductive success.
Do not lower the 20-breeder threshold after movement outcomes are opened.
Do not use a two-colony Royds/Crozier subset as a rescue if the three-colony performance gate removes too many events.
Do not change the one-year lookback after movement outcomes are opened.
